notes.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. fear

items.name: Supple Wrist
items.text: Vorrea Talminari gains an additional reaction each round that can only be used for A Foolish Move.

items.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Fear
A Foolish Move
items.text:
Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature critically misses Vorrea Talminari with a melee Strike or melee spell attack

---
Effect Vorrea makes an Arcane Strike against the triggering creature using Gouging Claw but becomes Slowed 1 for her next turn.

items.name: Focus from Fear
items.text: Though fear weakens Vorrea's other abilities, it hones her offensive abilities. She applies only half her frightened condition value as a penalty to attack rolls (rounded down) and applies a status bonus to damage dealt by her Strikes equal to her frightened value.

items.name: Phoenix's Sacrifice
items.text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your Dying condition increases

---
Effect The phoenix bursts into flames. You lose the dying condition and regain 1 Hit Point. Your Wounded value does not increase. You can use this action while Unconscious.

items.name: Quick Spike
items.text:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature within 15 feet uses a manipulate action

---
Effect An iron spike launches from your armor at the target, dealing 7d8 piercing damage to the target (DC 36 basic Reflex save save). If the target critically fails, the triggering action is disrupted.

items.name: Arcane Strike
items.text: Vorrea Talminari Casts a Spell that deals damage. She then makes a melee Strike that counts as two attacks for the purposes of her multiple attack penalty but doesn't apply this penalty until after her Arcane Strike is concluded. If the spell requires an attack roll, use the Strike's results to determine the effects of both the Strike and the spell. If the spell requires a save, the target of the Strike rolls its saving throw normally, though if the Strike was a critical failure, the target is unaffected. Spells used through Arcane Strike can affect only a single target, even if they would normally affect an area or multiple targets.

items.name: Commanding Draw
items.text:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You have a weapon sheathed in your Commandant's Scabbard

---
Effect You Interact to draw your weapon from your scabbard and Strike with it. On that Strike, you can roll twice and take the better result.

Effect: Commanding Draw

items.name: Fancy Bladework
items.text: Vorrea attempts an Intimidation check to demoralize each enemy within 30 feet, without suffering penalties for not sharing a language. Regardless of the result, each creature is temporarily immune to Fancy Bladework for 1 minute.

items.name: Paracountess's Parry
items.text:
Requirements Vorrea Talminari just used Arcane Strike

---
Effect Vorrea raises the wide hilt of her cutlass in a defensive posture, surrounded by arcane energies to defend herself. She gains a +2 circumstance bonus to her AC and resistance 5 to physical damage (except silver) until the start of her next turn.

Effect: Paracountess's Parry

items.name: Release Heat
items.text:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You have a free hand

---
Effect You take the heat that's built up in your gloves and discharge it onto an enemy. You deal 10d8 fire damage to one creature within reach (DC 31 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Steady Spellcasting
items.text: If a reaction would disrupt Vorrea's spellcasting action, she attempts a DC 15 Flat check. On a success, her action isn't disrupted.

items.name: Wind and Waves
items.text: Vorrea channels the elemental connection she has with the winds. She teleports to any square within 20 feet that's within reach of a creature, then makes a melee Strike. She can't use Wind and Waves again for 1d4 rounds.
